title: Translating Embeddings for Modeling Multi-relational Data
abstract_short: Introduces TransE, modeling relationships as translations in embedding space: h + r ≈ t. Simple, scalable, foundational KGE method.

title: A Three-Way Model for Collective Learning on Multi-Relational Data
abstract_short: Introduces RESCAL, a tensor factorization approach using bilinear products with relation-specific matrices for multi-relational data.

title: Embedding Entities and Relations for Learning and Inference in Knowledge Bases
abstract_short: Introduces DistMult, a simplified bilinear model for KGE. Unifies several models under one framework and achieves strong link prediction results.

title: Learning Entity and Relation Embeddings for Knowledge Graph Completion
abstract_short: Introduces TransR, projecting entities into relation-specific spaces before applying translational distance for KG embedding.

title: Knowledge Graph Embedding by Translating on Hyperplanes
abstract_short: Introduces TransH, enabling entities to have different representations for different relations via hyperplane projections.

title: Complex Embeddings for Simple Link Prediction
abstract_short: Introduces ComplEx, using complex-valued embeddings with Hermitian dot product to handle symmetric and antisymmetric relations efficiently.

title: Convolutional 2D Knowledge Graph Embeddings
abstract_short: Introduces ConvE, using 2D convolution over reshaped embeddings for link prediction. Identifies test set leakage in WN18 and FB15k, proposes WN18RR and FB15k-237.

title: RotatE: Knowledge Graph Embedding by Relational Rotation in Complex Space
abstract_short: Introduces RotatE, modeling relations as rotations in complex space. Handles symmetry, antisymmetry, inversion, and composition. Introduces self-adversarial negative sampling.

title: Holographic Embeddings of Knowledge Graphs
abstract_short: Introduces HolE, using circular correlation for compositional knowledge graph embeddings. Efficient and scalable.

title: SimplE Embedding for Link Prediction in Knowledge Graphs with Baseline Arithmetic
abstract_short: Introduces SimplE, an enhanced CP decomposition for KG link prediction. Fully expressive, interpretable, linear complexity.

title: TuckER: Tensor Factorization for Knowledge Graph Completion
abstract_short: Introduces TuckER based on Tucker decomposition. Shows several prior linear models (DistMult, ComplEx, SimplE) are special cases.

title: Modeling Relational Data with Graph Convolutional Networks
abstract_short: Introduces R-GCN for multi-relational data. Extends GCN with relation-specific weight matrices. Applied to link prediction and entity classification.

title: Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks
abstract_short: Introduces GCN using localized first-order approximation of spectral graph convolutions. Foundational work for all graph neural networks.

title: Graph Attention Networks
abstract_short: Introduces GAT, using masked self-attention for graph-structured data. Enables dynamic neighbor weighting without spectral methods.

title: KGAT: Knowledge Graph Attention Network for Recommendation
abstract_short: Introduces KGAT, combining KG with user-item graphs using attention for recommendation. Recursive neighbor embedding propagation with attention.

title: KG-BERT: BERT for Knowledge Graph Completion
abstract_short: Introduces KG-BERT, treating KG triples as text sequences and using BERT for triple classification, link prediction, and relation prediction.

title: KEPLER: A Unified Model for Knowledge Embedding and Pre-trained Language Representation
abstract_short: Introduces KEPLER, jointly optimizing KG embedding and language modeling objectives. Introduces Wikidata5M dataset.

title: Composition-based Multi-Relational Graph Convolutional Networks
abstract_short: Introduces CompGCN, jointly embedding nodes and relations using composition operators from KGE literature. Scales with number of relations.

title: InteractE: Improving Convolution-based Knowledge Graph Embeddings by Increasing Feature Interactions
abstract_short: Introduces InteractE, improving ConvE via feature permutation, reshaping, and circular convolution. 9% improvement on FB15k-237 over ConvE.

title: PairRE: Knowledge Graph Embeddings via Paired Relation Vectors
abstract_short: Introduces PairRE using paired relation vectors for adaptive margin adjustment. Handles complex N-to-N relations and multiple relation patterns.

title: Learning Hierarchy-Aware Knowledge Graph Embeddings for Link Prediction
abstract_short: Introduces HAKE, using polar coordinates to model semantic hierarchies. Radial coordinates encode hierarchy level, angular coordinates distinguish same-level entities.

title: NodePiece: Compositional and Parameter-Efficient Representations of Large Knowledge Graphs
abstract_short: Introduces NodePiece, anchor-based compositional entity representations for parameter-efficient KGE. 10x fewer parameters, works on unseen entities.

title: Towards Foundation Models for Knowledge Graph Reasoning
abstract_short: Introduces ULTRA, a foundation model for KG reasoning. Zero-shot inductive inference on unseen graphs with arbitrary relation vocabularies. Tested on 57 KGs.

title: A Review of Relational Machine Learning for Knowledge Graphs
abstract_short: Comprehensive survey of statistical relational learning for KGs. Covers latent feature models, observed feature models, and combination approaches.

title: A Survey on Knowledge Graphs: Representation, Acquisition and Applications
abstract_short: Comprehensive KG survey covering representation learning, knowledge acquisition, temporal KGs, and applications. Organizes approaches by space, scoring, encoding, and auxiliary info.

title: Knowledge Graph Embedding for Link Prediction: A Comparative Analysis
abstract_short: Comprehensive benchmark of 16 KGE methods. Shows aggregated metrics can mask poor performance on underrepresented entities.

title: Realistic Re-evaluation of Knowledge Graph Completion Methods: An Experimental Study
abstract_short: Identifies data redundancy in standard KG benchmarks (FB15k, WN18). Shows embedding models perform much worse when unrealistic triples are removed.

title: Knowledge Base Completion: Baseline strikes back (Again)
abstract_short: Shows ComplEx with comprehensive negative sampling matches or beats newer methods. Demonstrates multiplicative KBC methods become indistinguishable with proper training.

title: Bringing Light Into the Dark: A Large-scale Evaluation of Knowledge Graph Embedding Models Under a Unified Framework
abstract_short: PyKEEN benchmarking study. Re-implements 21 KGE models, finds model architecture + training approach + loss function + inverse relations all crucial. Large-scale reproducibility study.

title: Knowledge Vault: A Web-Scale Approach to Probabilistic Knowledge Fusion
abstract_short: Introduces Knowledge Vault, combining web extraction with prior knowledge from Freebase using supervised learning for probabilistic KG construction at web scale.

title: Freebase: A Collaboratively Created Graph Database For Structuring Human Knowledge
abstract_short: Introduces Freebase, a large-scale collaborative knowledge base. Foundation for Google Knowledge Graph and standard KGE benchmarks (FB15k).

title: Wikidata: A Free Collaborative Knowledgebase
abstract_short: Introduces Wikidata, a free collaborative knowledge base supporting Wikipedia. Structured data with multilingual support and community curation.

title: DBpedia: A Nucleus for a Web of Open Data
abstract_short: Introduces DBpedia, extracting structured content from Wikipedia. Foundational linked data resource and KG benchmark source.

title: Reasoning With Neural Tensor Networks for Knowledge Base Completion
abstract_short: Introduces Neural Tensor Network (NTN) for KB completion. Uses bilinear tensor product between entity vectors, enabling expressive relation modeling.

title: Knowledge Graph Completion via Complex Tensor Factorization
abstract_short: Extended journal version of ComplEx. Proves all real square matrices are real parts of unitarily diagonalizable matrices. Full theoretical analysis.

title: A Semantic Matching Energy Function for Learning with Multi-relational Data
abstract_short: Introduces Semantic Matching Energy (SME) model for multi-relational data using neural networks to encode entity-relation interactions.

title: Machine Knowledge: Creation and Curation of Comprehensive Knowledge Bases
abstract_short: Comprehensive survey of KG construction and curation. Covers entity discovery, canonicalization, taxonomy construction, and quality assurance.

title: Traversing Knowledge Graphs in Vector Space
abstract_short: Introduces compositional training for path queries on KGs. Recursive application of embedding models with structural regularization.

title: Knowledge Graph Embedding with Iterative Guidance from Soft Rules
abstract_short: Introduces RUGE, iteratively refining KGE using soft logical rules with varying confidence. Combines triples, unlabeled predictions, and rules.

title: Unifying Large Language Models and Knowledge Graphs: A Roadmap
abstract_short: Roadmap for LLM+KG integration. Three frameworks: KG-enhanced LLMs, LLM-augmented KGs, and synergized bidirectional approaches.

title: LLMs for Knowledge Graph Construction and Reasoning: Recent Capabilities and Future Opportunities
abstract_short: Evaluates LLMs on 8 KG datasets. Finds GPT-4 better as inference assistant than few-shot extractor. Introduces AutoKG multi-agent framework.

title: Head-to-Tail: How Knowledgeable are Large Language Models (LLMs)? A.K.A. Will LLMs Replace Knowledge Graphs?
abstract_short: Benchmark of 18K QA pairs by fact popularity. Shows LLMs fail on torso-to-tail entities, arguing KGs remain essential for factual knowledge.

title: Generations of Knowledge Graphs: The Crazy Ideas and the Business Impact
abstract_short: Traces KG evolution: entity-based KGs (Google/Bing), text-rich KGs (Amazon/Alibaba), dual neural KGs integrating with LLMs.

title: QA-GNN: Reasoning with Language Models and Knowledge Graphs for Question Answering
abstract_short: Introduces QA-GNN, combining LMs with KG subgraphs via joint reasoning with GNNs for commonsense and biomedical QA.

title: Graph Machine Learning in the Era of Large Language Models
abstract_short: Survey on LLM+Graph ML synergy. LLMs enhance graph feature quality; KGs ground LLMs with factual knowledge and reduce hallucinations.

title: OpenKE: An Open Toolkit for Knowledge Embedding
abstract_short: Open-source framework implementing major KGE models (TransE, TransH, TransR, TransD, DistMult, ComplEx, etc.) with GPU acceleration.

title: DGL-KE: Training Knowledge Graph Embeddings at Scale
abstract_short: Distributed training framework for KGE using DGL. Achieves 2-5x speedup over existing tools for large-scale KG embedding training.

title: Knowledge Graph Embedding via Dynamic Mapping Matrix
abstract_short: Introduces TransD, using dynamic mapping matrices constructed from entity and relation embeddings. More efficient than TransR.

title: Benchmark Dataset Leakage in Knowledge Graph Embedding
abstract_short: Identifies severe test set leakage via inverse relations in WN18 and FB15k. Proposes WN18RR and FB15k-237 as corrected benchmarks.

title: Learning Attention-based Embeddings for Relation Prediction in Knowledge Graphs
abstract_short: Attention-based KG embedding capturing entity and relation features in neighborhood. Incorporates relation clusters and multi-hop relations.

title: End-to-end Structure-Aware Convolutional Networks for Knowledge Base Completion
abstract_short: Introduces SACN combining WGCN encoder with Conv-TransE decoder. 10% improvement over ConvE on FB15k-237.

title: Interaction Embeddings for Prediction and Explanation in Knowledge Graphs
abstract_short: Introduces CrossE modeling crossover interactions between entities and relations. Generates triple-specific embeddings and provides explainable predictions.

title: Exploring the Potential of Large Language Models (LLMs) in Learning on Graphs
abstract_short: Examines LLMs for graph learning, particularly node classification. LLMs can enhance node attributes or serve as standalone graph predictors.

title: YAGO: A Core of Semantic Knowledge
abstract_short: Introduces YAGO, merging WordNet with Wikipedia to create a large-scale semantic knowledge base with high accuracy.

title: On the Ambiguity of Rank-Based Evaluation of Entity Alignment or Link Prediction Methods
abstract_short: Identifies issues with rank-based evaluation metrics for KGE. Test set size variations inappropriately affect measurements. Proposes fairer evaluation.

title: Improving Knowledge Graph Embedding Using Simple Constraints
abstract_short: Applies non-negativity constraints on entity embeddings and entailment constraints on relation embeddings to improve KGE interpretability and performance.

title: Inductive Representation Learning on Large Graphs
abstract_short: GraphSAGE: inductive framework for generating node embeddings by sampling and aggregating features from local neighborhoods

title: How Powerful are Graph Neural Networks?

title: Neural Message Passing for Quantum Chemistry
abstract_short: MPNN: unifying framework for graph neural networks as message passing; generalizes existing models into common message, update, readout phases

title: Spectral Networks and Locally Connected Networks on Graphs
abstract_short: First paper proposing spectral graph convolutions using graph Laplacian eigenvectors to generalize CNNs to graph-structured data

title: Convolutional Neural Networks on Graphs with Fast Localized Spectral Filtering
abstract_short: ChebNet: uses Chebyshev polynomial approximation of spectral graph convolutions for O(K|E|) filtering with K-localized support

title: Residual Gated Graph ConvNets
abstract_short: GatedGCN: introduces edge gating mechanism and residual connections for graph convolutions, showing ConvNets are 3-17% more accurate than graph RNNs

title: Hierarchical Graph Representation Learning with Differentiable Pooling
abstract_short: DiffPool: differentiable graph pooling that learns soft cluster assignments for hierarchical graph representation, improving graph classification by 5-10%

title: A Generalization of Transformer Networks to Graphs
abstract_short: Graph Transformer: generalizes transformer architecture to graphs with Laplacian eigenvector positional encodings, edge representations, and batch normalization

title: Recipe for a General, Powerful, Scalable Graph Transformer
abstract_short: GPS: modular graph transformer framework with O(N+E) complexity combining positional/structural encoding, local message-passing, and global attention

title: Weisfeiler and Leman Go Neural: Higher-order Graph Neural Networks
abstract_short: Relates GNN expressiveness to 1-WL test; proposes k-dimensional GNNs (k-GNNs) that capture higher-order graph structures beyond standard message passing

title: Understanding over-squashing and bottlenecks on graphs via curvature
abstract_short: Introduces edge-based combinatorial curvature to explain over-squashing; proves negatively curved edges cause information bottlenecks; proposes curvature-based graph rewiring

title: Principal Neighbourhood Aggregation for Graph Nets
abstract_short: PNA: combines multiple aggregators (mean, max, min, std) with degree-scalers to increase expressive power of GNNs for continuous features

title: DeepWalk: Online Learning of Social Representations
abstract_short: DeepWalk: learns graph node embeddings using random walks and Skip-gram (Word2Vec), treating random walk sequences as sentences

title: node2vec: Scalable Feature Learning for Networks
abstract_short: node2vec: biased random walk procedure with BFS/DFS-like exploration for flexible network neighborhood definition and node embedding

title: LINE: Large-scale Information Network Embedding
abstract_short: LINE: preserves first-order and second-order proximity in network embeddings; scalable to millions of nodes via edge-sampling SGD

title: A Comprehensive Survey on Graph Neural Networks
abstract_short: Comprehensive GNN survey: taxonomy into RecGNNs, ConvGNNs, GAEs, and STGNNs; covers spectral and spatial methods, pooling, and applications

title: Graph Neural Networks: A Review of Methods and Applications
abstract_short: GNN survey proposing general design pipeline; systematically categorizes GNN variants (GCN, GAT, GRN) and applications across domains

title: Geometric Deep Learning: Grids, Groups, Graphs, Geodesics, and Gauges
abstract_short: Unifying framework for deep learning through geometry and symmetry: CNNs, GNNs, Transformers as instances of geometric blueprint on grids, groups, graphs, geodesics, gauges

abstract_short: PyG: PyTorch-based library for deep learning on graphs with sparse GPU acceleration, dedicated CUDA kernels, and efficient mini-batch handling

abstract_short: DGL: framework-agnostic library for GNNs with generalized sparse tensor operations; supports arbitrary message handling and propagation rules

title: Benchmarking Graph Neural Networks
abstract_short: Principled GNN benchmark framework with diverse graph datasets enabling fair model comparison with fixed parameter budget; open-source reproducible infrastructure

title: Representation Learning on Graphs with Jumping Knowledge Networks
abstract_short: JK-Net: flexibly leverages different neighborhood ranges per node via jumping knowledge connections to enable better structure-aware representation and mitigate over-smoothing

title: GraphSAINT: Graph Sampling Based Inductive Learning Method
abstract_short: GraphSAINT: scalable GNN training via graph-level sampling of subgraphs with normalization for bias elimination and sampling for variance reduction

title: The Graph Neural Network Model
abstract_short: Original GNN: extends neural networks to graph-structured data via iterative message passing until fixed-point convergence; foundational work defining the GNN paradigm

title: GNNExplainer: Generating Explanations for Graph Neural Networks
abstract_short: GNNExplainer: first model-agnostic approach for post-hoc explanations of GNN predictions; identifies compact subgraph structures and node features important for predictions

title: Sign and Basis Invariant Networks for Spectral Graph Representation Learning
abstract_short: SignNet/BasisNet: neural architectures invariant to sign flips and basis symmetries of eigenvectors; provably more expressive than existing spectral GNN methods

title: Rethinking Graph Transformers with Spectral Attention
abstract_short: SAN: Spectral Attention Network using learned positional encodings from full Laplacian spectrum; first fully-connected architecture to perform well on graph benchmarks

title: Open Graph Benchmark: Datasets for Machine Learning on Graphs
abstract_short: OGB: diverse, large-scale benchmark datasets for graph ML covering social networks, biology, molecular graphs, source code ASTs, and knowledge graphs

title: Graph Contrastive Learning with Augmentations
abstract_short: GraphCL: contrastive learning framework for unsupervised graph representation learning using four augmentation types: node dropping, edge perturbation, attribute masking, subgraph

title: Simplifying Graph Convolutional Networks
abstract_short: SGC: removes nonlinearities and collapses weight matrices in GCN, showing the resulting linear model is a fixed low-pass filter; up to 100x speedup over FastGCN

title: Predict then Propagate: Graph Neural Networks meet Personalized PageRank
abstract_short: APPNP: derives propagation scheme from personalized PageRank for GNNs; enables large adjustable neighborhood while maintaining training efficiency

title: How Attentive are Graph Attention Networks?
abstract_short: GATv2: shows original GAT computes static attention (rankings unconditioned on query); proposes dynamic attention variant that is strictly more expressive

title: E(n) Equivariant Graph Neural Networks
abstract_short: EGNN: equivariant to rotations, translations, reflections, and permutations without expensive higher-order representations; scalable to arbitrary dimensions

title: SchNet: A continuous-filter convolutional neural network for modeling quantum interactions
abstract_short: SchNet: continuous-filter convolutional layers for modeling molecular quantum interactions with rotationally invariant energy predictions and smooth potential energy surfaces

title: Directional Message Passing for Molecular Graphs
abstract_short: DimeNet: directional message passing using angles between messages with spherical Bessel functions and spherical harmonics; outperforms previous GNNs by 76% on MD17

title: Attention Is All You Need
abstract_short: Transformer: self-attention mechanism replacing recurrence and convolutions; foundational architecture adapted by graph transformers

title: Heterogeneous Graph Attention Network
abstract_short: HAN: hierarchical attention for heterogeneous graphs with node-level and semantic-level (meta-path) attention for aggregating multi-type node features

title: Relational inductive biases, deep learning, and graph networks
abstract_short: Graph Networks: unifying framework with relational inductive biases; generalizes and extends MPNN, Interaction Networks, and other graph-based approaches

title: Deeper Insights into Graph Convolutional Networks for Semi-Supervised Learning
abstract_short: Shows GCN convolution is Laplacian smoothing, explaining why GCNs work and why deep GCNs suffer from over-smoothing; proposes co-training and self-training solutions

title: Variational Graph Auto-Encoders
abstract_short: VGAE: first variational auto-encoder for graph-structured data using GCN encoder and inner product decoder for unsupervised learning and link prediction

title: Gated Graph Sequence Neural Networks
abstract_short: GG-NN: modifies GNN to use GRU gating mechanism with modern optimization; extends to output sequences for program verification and graph generation tasks

title: Convolutional Networks on Graphs for Learning Molecular Fingerprints
abstract_short: Neural graph fingerprints: end-to-end learnable graph convolutions replacing circular fingerprints for molecular property prediction; early spatial graph convolution work

title: Equivariant Subgraph Aggregation Networks
abstract_short: ESAN: represents graphs as sets of subgraphs; strictly more expressive than 1-WL with novel WL variants for analyzing subgraph-based expressivity

title: Self-Attention Graph Pooling
abstract_short: SAGPool: uses graph convolution-based self-attention to score and select nodes for hierarchical graph pooling, considering both features and topology

title: Temporal Graph Networks for Deep Learning on Dynamic Graphs
abstract_short: TGN: generic framework for deep learning on dynamic graphs as sequences of timed events, combining memory modules with graph-based operators

title: EvolveGCN: Evolving Graph Convolutional Networks for Dynamic Graphs
abstract_short: EvolveGCN: uses RNN to evolve GCN parameters over time for dynamic graphs without requiring node embeddings across timesteps

title: Interaction Networks for Learning about Objects, Relations and Physics
abstract_short: Interaction Networks: learns to reason about object interactions and physical dynamics via neural network operating on graphs of objects and relations

title: Learning to Simulate Complex Physics with Graph Networks
abstract_short: GNS: particle-based physics simulation via learned message-passing on graphs; generalizes to different conditions, longer rollouts, and 10x more particles

title: Weisfeiler and Lehman Go Cellular: CW Networks
abstract_short: CW Networks: topological message passing on cell complexes; strictly more powerful than 1-WL and not less than 3-WL; excels on molecular graph problems

title: Weisfeiler and Leman go Machine Learning: The Story so far
abstract_short: Comprehensive survey of WL algorithm in ML: theoretical properties, graph kernels, supervised representation learning, and connections to equivariant neural architectures

title: Graph Neural Networks with Learnable Structural and Positional Representations
abstract_short: LSPE: learnable structural and positional encodings for GNNs; introduces RWPE (random walk PE) which avoids sign ambiguity of Laplacian PE

title: DropEdge: Towards Deep Graph Convolutional Networks on Node Classification
abstract_short: DropEdge: randomly removes edges during training to alleviate over-fitting and over-smoothing in deep GCNs, acting as data augmenter and message passing reducer

title: Cluster-GCN: An Efficient Algorithm for Training Deep and Large Graph Convolutional Networks
abstract_short: ClusterGCN: exploits graph clustering for efficient minibatch SGD training of deep GCNs; reduces memory and computation costs that grow exponentially with layers

title: GraphNorm: A Principled Approach to Accelerating Graph Neural Network Training
abstract_short: GraphNorm: graph-level normalization with learnable shift that serves as preconditioner smoothing aggregation spectrum; accelerates training and improves generalization

title: GraphRNN: Generating Realistic Graphs with Deep Auto-regressive Models
abstract_short: GraphRNN: autoregressive graph generation model decomposing generation into node/edge additions using hierarchical RNN; scales to 50x larger graphs than previous deep models

title: Strategies for Pre-training Graph Neural Networks
abstract_short: Pre-training strategy for GNNs: node-level then graph-level pre-training avoids negative transfer; up to 9.4% improvement for molecular property and protein function prediction

title: GraphMAE: Self-Supervised Masked Graph Autoencoders
abstract_short: GraphMAE: masked graph autoencoder with feature reconstruction using scaled cosine error for generative self-supervised learning; outperforms contrastive methods on 21 datasets

title: Long Range Graph Benchmark
abstract_short: LRGB: 5 graph datasets requiring long-range interaction reasoning; evaluates GNN limitations in capturing distant node dependencies

title: Order Matters: Sequence to sequence for sets
abstract_short: Set2Set: attention-based read-process-and-write model for input sets using content-based attention; adopted as graph-level readout in GNNs

abstract_short: Early geometric deep learning survey: generalizing deep learning to non-Euclidean domains (graphs and manifolds); establishes the field's foundations

label: Message Passing
description: Core GNN paradigm where nodes exchange information with neighbors via message, aggregate, and update functions iteratively

label: Spectral Graph Convolution
description: Convolution defined in the spectral domain via graph Laplacian eigenvectors; theoretical foundation for early GNNs

label: Spatial Graph Convolution
description: Convolution defined directly in the spatial domain by aggregating information from local neighborhoods

label: Graph Attention Mechanism
description: Mechanism for learning different importance weights for different neighbors during aggregation

label: Graph Pooling
description: Methods to compute graph-level representations from node-level features via hierarchical coarsening or global readout

label: Over-smoothing
description: Phenomenon where node representations converge to similar values as GNN depth increases, losing discriminative power

label: Over-squashing
description: Phenomenon where information from distant nodes gets compressed/distorted when passing through graph bottlenecks

label: Weisfeiler-Leman Test
description: Graph isomorphism heuristic that iteratively refines node colors based on neighborhood multisets; upper bounds GNN expressive power

label: Graph Isomorphism
description: Problem of determining whether two graphs are structurally identical; central to understanding GNN expressiveness

label: Node Embedding
description: Mapping graph nodes to low-dimensional continuous vector representations preserving structural/feature information

label: Random Walk on Graphs
description: Stochastic process on graphs used for node embedding (DeepWalk, Node2Vec) and positional encoding (RWPE)

label: Graph Transformer
description: Adaptation of transformer architecture to graph-structured data with positional encodings and optional edge features

label: Equivariance
description: Property where network output transforms predictably under input symmetries (rotations, translations, permutations)

label: Graph Generation
description: Task of generating new graphs with desired properties; applications in drug discovery and material design

label: Node Classification
description: Task of predicting labels for unlabeled nodes given partial labels and graph structure

label: Graph Classification
description: Task of predicting properties or labels of entire graphs; key in molecular property prediction and social network analysis

label: Positional Encoding for Graphs
description: Methods to encode node positions in graphs for transformers: Laplacian eigenvectors, random walks, or learned encodings

label: Graph Rewiring
description: Modifying graph topology to improve information flow, mitigate over-squashing/over-smoothing, or add long-range connections

label: Contrastive Learning on Graphs
description: Self-supervised learning paradigm maximizing agreement between augmented graph views for unsupervised graph representation learning

label: Graph Laplacian
description: Matrix encoding graph structure whose eigendecomposition provides spectral basis for graph signal processing and GNN positional encodings

label: Higher-order GNN
description: GNN architectures that go beyond pairwise interactions to model k-tuples of nodes, exceeding 1-WL expressivity

label: Heterogeneous Graph
description: Graphs with multiple types of nodes and/or edges; require type-specific aggregation and meta-path-based reasoning

label: Dynamic Graph
description: Graphs whose structure and/or features change over time; require temporal modeling alongside structural learning

label: GNN Scalability
description: Techniques for training GNNs on large graphs: sampling (node, layer, subgraph), clustering, and distributed approaches

label: GNN Expressiveness
description: Ability of GNN architectures to distinguish non-isomorphic graphs; bounded by WL hierarchy for message-passing GNNs

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
definition: Architecture pattern that combines information retrieval from external knowledge sources with neural text generation, enabling LLMs to access up-to-date or domain-specific knowledge beyond their training data.

title: Dense Passage Retrieval
definition: Technique using learned dense vector representations (embeddings) from dual-encoder models to retrieve relevant passages, replacing sparse keyword-based methods like BM25.

title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting
definition: Prompting technique that elicits step-by-step intermediate reasoning from LLMs before producing a final answer, dramatically improving performance on complex reasoning tasks.

title: Tool Use / Function Calling in LLMs
definition: Capability of LLMs to invoke external tools, APIs, or functions during generation, extending their abilities beyond text to include computation, search, code execution, and more.

title: LLM-based Autonomous Agent
definition: System using an LLM as a central controller for perception, reasoning, planning, and action execution, often with memory modules and tool access to accomplish complex tasks autonomously.

title: Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA)
definition: Task of answering natural language questions by reasoning over structured knowledge graphs, often combining graph neural networks or graph traversal with language models.

title: Knowledge Editing in LLMs
definition: Methods for directly modifying specific factual associations stored in LLM parameters without full retraining, targeting localized computations in feed-forward layers.

title: Hallucination Detection and Mitigation
definition: Techniques for identifying and reducing factually incorrect, unsupported, or fabricated content generated by LLMs, including retrieval augmentation, self-verification, and atomic fact evaluation.

title: Self-Reflection in LLM Agents
definition: Mechanism where LLM agents evaluate their own outputs, generate verbal feedback, and use it to iteratively improve responses or decision-making across episodes.

title: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF)
definition: Training methodology that aligns LLM outputs with human preferences using reward models trained on human rankings, then optimizing the LLM via reinforcement learning (typically PPO).

title: Structured Output / Constrained Decoding
definition: Methods ensuring LLM outputs conform to predefined formats (JSON, XML, grammars) by constraining token selection during decoding, enabling reliable integration with downstream systems.

title: Reasoning Paradigms (CoT, ToT, GoT)
definition: Family of prompting and inference strategies that structure LLM reasoning as chains (sequential), trees (branching with backtracking), or graphs (arbitrary dependencies between thoughts).

title: Embodied LLM Agent
definition: LLM-powered agents that interact with virtual or physical environments, learning skills through exploration, feedback, and code generation for open-ended task completion.

title: Agent-Computer Interface (ACI)
definition: Specialized interfaces designed for LLM agents to interact with computer environments (file systems, terminals, browsers), optimizing for agent rather than human usability.

title: Factuality Evaluation for LLMs
definition: Benchmarks and metrics for measuring the factual accuracy of LLM generations, including atomic fact decomposition, knowledge-source verification, and truthfulness scoring.

title: Multi-Agent LLM Systems
definition: Architectures where multiple LLM-based agents collaborate, debate, or specialize in different roles to solve complex tasks, often with shared memory and communication protocols.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Pre-training
definition: Pre-training paradigm that jointly trains a retriever and language model, enabling the model to learn to retrieve and reason over external knowledge during the pre-training phase.

title: LLM and Knowledge Graph Integration
definition: Approaches combining LLMs with structured knowledge graphs for enhanced reasoning, including KG-enhanced LLMs, LLM-augmented KGs, and synergized systems.

title: LLM Code Generation
definition: Application of LLMs to automatically generate, complete, debug, and reason about source code, evaluated via benchmarks like HumanEval and SWE-bench.

title: Agentic Coding Assistants
definition: AI coding tools that go beyond autocomplete to autonomously navigate codebases, plan multi-file changes, run tests, and resolve real software engineering tasks.

title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
definition: Open standard by Anthropic for LLM-tool integration using client-server architecture with JSON-RPC, providing Tools, Resources, and Prompts primitives for standardized agent-tool communication.

title: Iterative/Active Retrieval
definition: RAG variants that dynamically decide when and what to retrieve during generation based on confidence signals, rather than retrieving only once before generation.

title: Knowledge Neurons
definition: Specific neurons in transformer feed-forward layers whose activation correlates with expression of particular factual knowledge, identified via gradient-based attribution methods.

title: Verbal Reinforcement Learning
definition: Agent learning paradigm where feedback and experience are stored as natural language reflections rather than numeric rewards, enabling learning without weight updates.

title: Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate
abstract_short: Introduces the attention mechanism for neural machine translation, allowing the decoder to soft-search over source positions

title: Batch Normalization: Accelerating Deep Network Training by Reducing Internal Covariate Shift
abstract_short: Introduces batch normalization to stabilize and accelerate deep network training by normalizing layer inputs

title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
abstract_short: Introduces residual connections (skip connections) enabling training of very deep networks, winning ILSVRC 2015

title: Layer Normalization
abstract_short: Proposes layer normalization as an alternative to batch normalization, computing statistics across features instead of batch dimension

title: Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training
abstract_short: Introduces GPT: generative pre-training of a Transformer language model on unlabeled text followed by discriminative fine-tuning

title: Deep Contextualized Word Representations
abstract_short: Introduces ELMo: contextualized word representations learned from bidirectional LSTM language model internal states

title: Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners
abstract_short: Introduces GPT-2, showing language models can learn tasks without explicit supervision when trained on WebText corpus

title: Transformer-XL: Attentive Language Models Beyond a Fixed-Length Context
abstract_short: Introduces segment-level recurrence and relative positional encoding to enable Transformers to learn dependencies beyond fixed context

title: XLNet: Generalized Autoregressive Pretraining for Language Understanding
abstract_short: Combines autoregressive and autoencoding via permutation language modeling, overcoming BERT limitations while capturing bidirectional context

title: RoBERTa: A Robustly Optimized BERT Pretraining Approach
abstract_short: Demonstrates BERT was significantly undertrained and proposes optimized pretraining recipe with larger batches, more data, and no NSP

title: ALBERT: A Lite BERT for Self-supervised Learning of Language Representations
abstract_short: Reduces BERT parameters via cross-layer sharing and factorized embedding, enabling larger effective capacity with fewer parameters

title: Generating Long Sequences with Sparse Transformers
abstract_short: Introduces sparse factorizations of attention reducing O(n^2) to O(n*sqrt(n)) for modeling long sequences

title: DistilBERT, a distilled version of BERT: smaller, faster, cheaper and lighter
abstract_short: Applies knowledge distillation to BERT, producing a model 60% faster and 40% smaller while retaining 97% performance

title: Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer
abstract_short: Introduces T5: frames every NLP task as text-to-text and systematically studies transfer learning factors at scale

title: BART: Denoising Sequence-to-Sequence Pre-training for Natural Language Generation, Translation, and Comprehension
abstract_short: Introduces BART, a denoising autoencoder combining bidirectional encoder with autoregressive decoder for sequence-to-sequence pretraining

title: ELECTRA: Pre-training Text Encoders as Discriminators Rather Than Generators
abstract_short: Proposes replaced token detection pretraining: discriminating real from generated tokens, more efficient than masked language modeling

title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
abstract_short: Discovers power-law scaling relationships between language model performance and model size, dataset size, and compute budget

title: Longformer: The Long-Document Transformer
abstract_short: Introduces attention mechanism combining local sliding window with global attention, scaling linearly with sequence length

title: Reformer: The Efficient Transformer
abstract_short: Uses locality-sensitive hashing attention and reversible residual layers to reduce Transformer memory and compute to O(L log L)

title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
abstract_short: Introduces Vision Transformer (ViT): applies standard Transformer directly to sequences of image patches for image classification

title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
abstract_short: Introduces CLIP: contrastive learning between images and text at scale, enabling zero-shot visual classification

title: DeBERTa: Decoding-enhanced BERT with Disentangled Attention
abstract_short: Introduces disentangled attention using separate vectors for content and position, plus enhanced mask decoder for pretraining

title: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
abstract_short: Simplifies MoE routing to achieve trillion-parameter sparse models with 4x speedup over T5-XXL using efficient sparsity

title: RoFormer: Enhanced Transformer with Rotary Position Embedding
abstract_short: Proposes Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) encoding absolute position with rotation matrices while incorporating relative position dependency

title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
abstract_short: Proposes low-rank adaptation for efficient fine-tuning of large language models by injecting trainable rank decomposition matrices

title: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways
abstract_short: Scales a 540B parameter dense Transformer using Pathways system, demonstrating breakthrough capabilities and discontinuous improvements

title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models
abstract_short: Derives Chinchilla scaling laws showing models should be trained on ~20x more tokens than parameters for compute-optimal training

title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
abstract_short: IO-aware exact attention algorithm using tiling to minimize HBM accesses, achieving 2-4x wall-clock speedup with no approximation

title: Scaling Instruction-Finetuned Language Models
abstract_short: Introduces Flan-T5/PaLM: instruction finetuning scaled across tasks, model sizes, and chain-of-thought data dramatically improves performance

title: GQA: Training Generalized Multi-Query Transformer Models from Multi-Head Checkpoints
abstract_short: Proposes grouped-query attention (GQA) interpolating between multi-head and multi-query attention for efficient inference

title: LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models
abstract_short: Releases open-source foundation models (7B-65B) competitive with proprietary models, trained on publicly available data following Chinchilla scaling

title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models
abstract_short: Releases open-source LLaMA 2 (7B-70B) with RLHF-aligned chat models approaching closed-source model performance

title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
abstract_short: Eliminates separate reward model in RLHF by directly optimizing policy with preference data using a classification loss

title: Mistral 7B
abstract_short: Introduces Mistral 7B with grouped-query attention and sliding window attention, outperforming Llama 2 13B on all benchmarks

title: Mixtral of Experts
abstract_short: Introduces Mixtral 8x7B sparse MoE model using router-selected 2-of-8 experts per layer, matching GPT-3.5 quality

title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
abstract_short: Proposes selective state space model with input-dependent selection and hardware-aware design, matching Transformer quality at linear time

title: Gemini: A Family of Highly Capable Multimodal Models
abstract_short: Introduces Gemini multimodal models (Ultra/Pro/Nano) achieving state-of-the-art on 30/32 benchmarks and first human-expert MMLU performance

title: FlashAttention-2: Faster Attention with Better Parallelism and Work Partitioning
abstract_short: Improves FlashAttention with better work partitioning and parallelism, achieving 2x speedup over FlashAttention and 5-9x over standard attention

title: The Llama 3 Herd of Models
abstract_short: Introduces Llama 3 family including 405B dense Transformer supporting multilinguality, coding, reasoning, and tool usage

title: Transformers are RNNs: Fast Autoregressive Transformers with Linear Attention
abstract_short: Expresses attention as linear dot-product of kernel feature maps, reducing complexity from O(N^2) to O(N) for sequence modeling

title: On Layer Normalization in the Transformer Architecture
abstract_short: Analyzes Pre-LN vs Post-LN Transformer variants, showing Pre-LN enables stable training without careful warmup

title: RWKV: Reinventing RNNs for the Transformer Era
abstract_short: Proposes RWKV combining RNN efficiency with Transformer parallelism via linear attention for competitive language modeling

title: Self-Attention Mechanism
description: Mechanism where each position in a sequence attends to all other positions, computing weighted sums based on query-key compatibility. Foundation of Transformer architecture.

title: Multi-Head Attention
description: Runs multiple attention functions in parallel with different learned projections, allowing the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces.

title: Masked Language Modeling (MLM)
description: Pre-training objective where random tokens are masked and the model learns to predict them from bidirectional context. Core to BERT-family models.

title: Autoregressive Language Modeling
description: Left-to-right language modeling predicting the next token given all previous tokens. Core to GPT-family models.

title: Transfer Learning
description: Pre-training on large unlabeled corpus then fine-tuning on downstream tasks. Paradigm shift that made pre-trained models standard in NLP.

title: Encoder-Decoder Architecture
description: Architecture with an encoder that processes input into representations and a decoder that generates output. Used in seq2seq, T5, BART.

title: Positional Encoding
description: Methods for injecting sequence order information into Transformers: sinusoidal, learned, relative, rotary (RoPE). Essential since attention is permutation-invariant.

title: Word Embeddings
description: Dense vector representations of words capturing semantic and syntactic relationships. Foundation for neural NLP from Word2Vec through contextual embeddings.

title: In-Context Learning
description: Ability of large language models to learn tasks from examples provided in the prompt without gradient updates. Emerged with GPT-3.

title: Scaling Laws
description: Power-law relationships between model performance and compute, parameters, and data. Guide efficient allocation of training resources.

title: Knowledge Distillation
description: Training a smaller student model to mimic a larger teacher model, compressing knowledge while maintaining performance. Used in DistilBERT.

title: Mixture of Experts (MoE)
description: Architecture using multiple expert sub-networks with a routing mechanism selecting which experts process each input. Enables sparse scaling.

title: Sparse Attention
description: Attention patterns that attend to subset of positions instead of all, reducing quadratic complexity. Includes local, strided, LSH-based patterns.

title: Contrastive Learning
description: Learning representations by contrasting positive pairs against negative pairs. Used in CLIP for vision-language alignment.

title: Instruction Tuning
description: Fine-tuning language models on diverse tasks formatted as instructions, improving zero-shot generalization. Used in Flan-T5, InstructGPT.

title: State Space Models (SSM)
description: Sequence models inspired by continuous-time state spaces, offering linear-time complexity. Alternative to attention for long sequences. Includes S4, Mamba.

title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT)
description: Methods for adapting large models by training only a small number of parameters: LoRA, adapters, prefix tuning. Essential for deploying LLMs.

title: Residual Connections
description: Skip connections adding input directly to layer output, enabling gradient flow in deep networks. Critical component of Transformers.

title: Normalization Techniques
description: Methods for stabilizing neural network training: batch norm, layer norm, RMS norm. Layer norm is standard in Transformers.

title: Tokenization
description: Segmenting text into subword units (BPE, WordPiece, SentencePiece) for model input. Determines vocabulary and representation granularity.

title: Vision Transformer
description: Applying Transformer architecture to computer vision by treating image patches as tokens. Challenges CNN dominance in vision tasks.

title: Multimodal Models
description: Models processing multiple input modalities (text, image, audio, video). Includes CLIP, GPT-4V, Gemini.

title: AI Alignment
description: Techniques for making AI systems behave according to human values and intentions: RLHF, Constitutional AI, DPO. Critical for safe deployment.

title: Open-Source LLMs
description: Openly released large language model weights enabling community research and deployment. LLaMA, Mistral, Falcon catalyzed the open-source LLM movement.

name: Trust & Reputation Systems
description: Computational frameworks for establishing, propagating, and aggregating trust between agents in distributed systems, online marketplaces, and social networks

name: Epistemic Logic
description: Formal logical systems for reasoning about knowledge, belief, and information states of agents; foundations for multi-agent systems and game theory

name: Formal Verification
description: Mathematical techniques for proving correctness of hardware and software systems, including model checking, theorem proving, and deductive verification

name: Model Checking
description: Algorithmic technique for automatically verifying finite-state systems against temporal logic specifications; Turing Award 2007 (Clarke, Emerson, Sifakis)

name: Proof Assistants & Interactive Theorem Provers
description: Software tools that help users construct formal mathematical proofs, including Coq/Rocq, Lean, and Isabelle/HOL

name: Zero-Knowledge Proofs
description: Cryptographic protocols where a prover can convince a verifier that a statement is true without revealing any information beyond the validity of the statement

name: Citation Analysis & Bibliometrics
description: Quantitative study of scientific publications, citation patterns, and their use in evaluating research impact and mapping knowledge networks

name: Scientometrics
description: The science of measuring and analyzing scientific activity, including bibliometric laws (Lotka, Bradford, Zipf) and impact metrics (h-index, Impact Factor)

name: Reproducibility Crisis
description: Systemic failure to replicate published research findings, affecting psychology, biomedicine, and other fields; driven by publication bias, p-hacking, and incentive misalignment

name: Pre-registration & Open Science
description: Movement to register hypotheses and analysis plans before data collection, distinguishing prediction from postdiction to combat p-hacking and HARKing

name: Bayesian Epistemology
description: Philosophical framework treating degrees of belief as probabilities, using Bayes' theorem for belief updating; foundations for accuracy-first epistemology

name: Dempster-Shafer Evidence Theory
description: Mathematical framework for reasoning under uncertainty using belief functions, generalizing Bayesian probability to handle ignorance and conflicting evidence

name: Link Analysis & Web Graph Algorithms
description: Algorithms that exploit hyperlink structure to rank web pages and identify authoritative sources, including PageRank and HITS

name: Confidence Calibration
description: Ensuring that predicted probabilities match empirical frequencies; critical for trustworthy ML systems and decision-making under uncertainty

name: Sybil Resistance
description: Techniques to prevent adversaries from creating multiple fake identities to subvert distributed systems and reputation mechanisms

name: Provenance & Content Authenticity
description: Systems for tracking the origin, history, and transformations of data and digital content, including W3C PROV and C2PA standards

name: Automated Fact Verification
description: NLP and IR techniques for automatically checking claims against evidence sources, including dataset benchmarks like FEVER

name: Distributed Consensus & Ordering
description: Fundamental problems of agreement, ordering, and consistency in distributed systems; foundations for blockchain and trustless protocols

name: Adversarial Robustness
description: Study of vulnerabilities in ML models to adversarial inputs and defenses against them; implications for trustworthy AI

name: Algorithmic Mechanism Design
description: Design of algorithms for settings where participants act in self-interest; connecting game theory and algorithm design for incentive-compatible systems

name: SMT Solvers & Automated Reasoning
description: Decision procedures for satisfiability modulo theories; foundational tools for software verification, program analysis, and constraint solving

title: The PageRank Citation Ranking: Bringing Order to the Web
abstract_short: Proposes PageRank, a method for ranking web pages by computing a probability distribution over pages using the link structure of the web as a Markov chain

title: Authoritative Sources in a Hyperlinked Environment
abstract_short: Introduces HITS algorithm: identifies hub and authority pages through mutually reinforcing relationships in hyperlink structure, enabling broad topic distillation

title: The EigenTrust Algorithm for Reputation Management in P2P Networks
abstract_short: Assigns global trust values in P2P networks via distributed power iteration, isolating malicious peers by aggregating local trust scores into a global reputation

title: Why Most Published Research Findings Are False
abstract_short: Demonstrates via probabilistic modeling that most published research findings are likely false due to bias, low statistical power, small effect sizes, and researcher degrees of freedom

title: Estimating the Reproducibility of Psychological Science
abstract_short: Large-scale replication of 100 psychology studies finds only 36% yield significant results on replication, with effect sizes halved on average

title: An Index to Quantify an Individual's Scientific Research Output
abstract_short: Proposes the h-index: a researcher has index h if h of their papers each have at least h citations, providing a single robust metric of research impact

title: Citation Indexes for Science: A New Dimension in Documentation through Association of Ideas
abstract_short: Proposes the concept of citation indexing for scientific literature, enabling retrieval through association of ideas rather than subject classification alone

title: Citation Analysis as a Tool in Journal Evaluation
abstract_short: Introduces the Impact Factor and journal citation analysis methodology, enabling systematic evaluation and comparison of scientific journals

title: Science Citation Index — A New Dimension in Indexing
abstract_short: Announces the creation of the Science Citation Index, providing the first comprehensive citation-based indexing system for scientific literature

title: Networks of Scientific Papers
abstract_short: Analyzes citation patterns as networks, revealing the structure of research fronts and the cumulative advantage process in scientific publication

title: Knowledge and Belief: An Introduction to the Logic of the Two Notions
abstract_short: Foundational treatise establishing epistemic logic with possible-worlds semantics for knowledge and belief operators, introducing the KK principle and epistemic axiom systems

title: Reasoning About Knowledge
abstract_short: Comprehensive treatment of epistemic logic applied to distributed systems, AI, and game theory; formalizes common knowledge, distributed knowledge, and multi-agent reasoning

title: Agreeing to Disagree
abstract_short: Proves that two Bayesian agents with a common prior cannot have common knowledge of differing posterior probabilities; formalizes common knowledge concept

title: Design and Synthesis of Synchronization Skeletons Using Branching Time Temporal Logic
abstract_short: Introduces algorithmic model checking: automated verification of concurrent program properties specified in CTL (Computation Tree Logic)

title: Specification and Verification of Concurrent Systems in CESAR
abstract_short: Presents the CESAR system for verifying concurrent processes against branching-time temporal logic specifications using interpreted Petri nets

title: The Knowledge Complexity of Interactive Proof Systems
abstract_short: Introduces zero-knowledge proofs: interactive proof systems where the verifier learns nothing beyond the validity of the statement being proved

title: The Sybil Attack
abstract_short: Proves that without centralized identity certification, Sybil attacks (one entity presenting multiple identities) are always possible in peer-to-peer systems

title: Upper and Lower Probabilities Induced by a Multivalued Mapping
abstract_short: Introduces upper and lower probability framework through multivalued mappings, providing the mathematical foundation for what becomes Dempster-Shafer evidence theory

title: A Mathematical Theory of Evidence
abstract_short: Develops belief functions as a mathematical framework for epistemic uncertainty, extending Dempster's combination rule into a complete theory of evidence

title: A Logic for Uncertain Probabilities
abstract_short: Introduces subjective logic: opinion-based reasoning framework combining Dempster-Shafer belief theory with logical operators for trust computation under uncertainty

title: The Calculus of Constructions
abstract_short: Presents the Calculus of Constructions: a higher-order typed lambda calculus serving as the theoretical foundation for the Coq (now Rocq) proof assistant

title: Isabelle/HOL: A Proof Assistant for Higher-Order Logic
abstract_short: Comprehensive introduction to the Isabelle/HOL interactive proof assistant for higher-order logic, covering proof methods, specification techniques, and automation

title: The Lean Theorem Prover (System Description)
abstract_short: Describes Lean: a new open-source theorem prover based on dependent type theory, bridging interactive and automated theorem proving with a small trusted kernel

title: Z3: An Efficient SMT Solver
abstract_short: Presents Z3: a high-performance SMT solver combining SAT solving with theory-specific decision procedures, widely used in software verification and program analysis

title: An Axiomatic Basis for Computer Programming
abstract_short: Introduces Hoare logic: an axiomatic system for proving partial correctness of programs using precondition-postcondition triples {P}S{Q}

title: Assigning Meanings to Programs
abstract_short: Pioneers program verification through logical assertions at control flow points, establishing the foundation for Hoare logic and formal program correctness proofs

title: The Temporal Logic of Programs
abstract_short: Introduces temporal logic as a formal framework for specifying and verifying properties of concurrent and reactive programs, unifying sequential and parallel verification

title: A Certified Digital Signature
abstract_short: Introduces Merkle trees (hash trees): a data structure enabling efficient and secure verification of data integrity through hierarchical cryptographic hashing

title: PROV-DM: The PROV Data Model
abstract_short: W3C Recommendation defining a data model for provenance of digital objects: entities, activities, agents, derivations, and bundles for provenance of provenance

title: C2PA Technical Specification v1.0
authors: Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity
abstract_short: Industry standard for content provenance enabling tamper-evident media through cryptographic binding of creation and editing metadata to digital assets

title: FEVER: a Large-scale Dataset for Fact Extraction and VERification
abstract_short: Introduces FEVER benchmark: 185K claims derived from Wikipedia, classified as Supported/Refuted/NotEnoughInfo with evidence sentences, enabling automated fact verification research

title: False-Positive Psychology: Undisclosed Flexibility in Data Collection and Analysis Allows Presenting Anything as Significant
abstract_short: Demonstrates that researcher degrees of freedom (p-hacking) can inflate false-positive rates from 5% to over 60%; proposes six disclosure requirements

title: The Preregistration Revolution
abstract_short: Advocates pre-registration of research hypotheses and analysis plans before data collection to distinguish confirmatory from exploratory research and combat publication bias

title: Drug Development: Raise Standards for Preclinical Cancer Research
abstract_short: Reports Amgen scientists failed to replicate 47 of 53 landmark preclinical cancer studies; calls for higher standards in methods, reporting, and validation

title: 1,500 Scientists Lift the Lid on Reproducibility
abstract_short: Nature survey of 1,576 researchers: 70%+ have failed to reproduce others' experiments; 52% agree there is a significant reproducibility crisis in science

title: Evaluating the Replicability of Social Science Experiments in Nature and Science between 2010 and 2015
abstract_short: Replicates 21 high-profile social science experiments from Nature and Science; 13 of 21 (62%) replicate with effect sizes about half of originals

title: A Nonpragmatic Vindication of Probabilism
abstract_short: Launches accuracy-first epistemology: using the Brier score shows that non-probabilistic credences are always dominated by closer-to-truth probabilistic ones

title: Reputation Systems
abstract_short: Defines the architecture and challenges of online reputation systems: collecting, distributing, and aggregating feedback to facilitate trust among strangers

title: Trust Among Strangers in Internet Transactions: Empirical Analysis of eBay's Reputation System
abstract_short: Empirical study of eBay showing feedback is overwhelmingly positive, reputation predicts performance, and buyer-seller ratings are highly correlated suggesting reciprocity

title: Formalising Trust as a Computational Concept
abstract_short: First PhD thesis formalizing computational trust: defines trust thresholds, situational trust, and dispositional trust for autonomous agents in distributed AI systems

title: Propagation of Trust and Distrust
abstract_short: Develops and evaluates trust propagation schemes on a network of 800K trust scores among 130K people; first to incorporate distrust in computational trust propagation

title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
abstract_short: Discovers modern deep networks are poorly calibrated despite high accuracy; finds temperature scaling is surprisingly effective as a single-parameter post-hoc calibration method

title: Obtaining Well Calibrated Probabilities Using Bayesian Binning into Quantiles
abstract_short: Proposes BBQ: a non-parametric Bayesian calibration method using binning into quantiles, improving probability calibration for binary classification

title: Algorithmic Learning in a Random World
abstract_short: Comprehensive treatment of conformal prediction: distribution-free framework providing valid prediction sets with guaranteed coverage under exchangeability assumption

title: The Semantic Web
abstract_short: Articulates the vision of the Semantic Web with layered architecture including a trust layer: machine-readable metadata enabling automated reasoning and agent cooperation

title: Decentralized Trust Management
abstract_short: Introduces PolicyMaker: a trust management framework separating trust policy from application logic, enabling decentralized authorization through programmable credentials

title: Making Sense of Credibility on the Web: Models for Evaluating Online Information
abstract_short: Reviews cognitive models of online credibility assessment, synthesizing communication and information literacy approaches to evaluating web-based information reliability

title: Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System
abstract_short: Proposes Bitcoin: a trustless peer-to-peer electronic cash system using proof-of-work consensus and a distributed ledger (blockchain) to eliminate trusted third parties

title: The Frequency Distribution of Scientific Productivity
abstract_short: Discovers the inverse square law of scientific productivity: the number of authors making n contributions is proportional to 1/n², establishing a fundamental bibliometric law

title: Sources of Information on Specific Subjects
abstract_short: Establishes Bradford's Law: articles on a subject are distributed across journals in zones of exponentially decreasing productivity, with core/scatter structure

title: Algorithmic Mechanism Design
abstract_short: Founds algorithmic mechanism design: designing algorithms for selfish agents where truthful behavior is incentive-compatible, bridging CS and economics

title: Intriguing Properties of Neural Networks
abstract_short: Discovers adversarial examples: imperceptible perturbations that cause neural networks to misclassify with high confidence, revealing fundamental discontinuities in learned representations

title: Explaining and Harnessing Adversarial Examples
abstract_short: Explains adversarial vulnerability through linear behavior of high-dimensional models; introduces Fast Gradient Sign Method (FGSM) for efficient adversarial example generation

title: The Official PGP User's Guide
abstract_short: Documents PGP public-key cryptography and its Web of Trust model: decentralized identity verification through transitive trust chains without certificate authorities
